fusions.name: Spring-Heel Drop
fusions.desc: A coiled spring in your heels launches you onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away, and the landing deals 15 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Recoil Bounce
fusions.desc: A piston in your boots bounces you in place, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Pogo Greaves
fusions.desc: Snaps out sprung stilts that hop you 3 tiles from where you stood, then raise your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tension Coil
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge winds a coil on you, up to 8. At 8 they all release at once: you move and attack 3% faster per coil (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a coil unwinds every 6 seconds.
